migrations.detect: project validate fails naming a populated legacy .vibehub/context/ directory (every Context lives in a room now).
steps: When .vibehub/rooms/ is missing or empty, build the Room tree first with the distill skill (cold start); do not invent rooms for territory you have not read.
Move every entry out of .vibehub/context/ into the lowest room that owns its claim, per the placement rule in the knowledge-governance reference, using git mv; remove the emptied directory.
Rewrite every ticket context_ref that names a .vibehub/context/ path to the entry's new roomed path.
Prove the result: project validate passes; align the rooms that received entries so drift is honest about what the migration touched.
